title: BetterAnvil
description: A lightweight plugin that removes the 'Too Expensive!' anvil limit and prevents exponential repair costs.
body:
⚒️ BetterAnvil
BetterAnvil is a lightweight, modern utility plugin for Paper and Spigot servers that fixes the most frustrating parts of the vanilla Minecraft anvil system. No more "Too Expensive!" errors—just pure gear progression.

✨ Key Features
Remove "Too Expensive!": Increases the vanilla repair limit from 40 levels up to a customizable 500 levels.

Infinite Repairs: Automatically resets the "Prior Work Penalty." This stops repair costs from doubling every time you use the anvil, allowing you to keep your favorite gear forever.

In-Game Management: Fully controllable via commands without needing to restart your server.

Modern API: Built using the latest Paper 1.21.x API for maximum performance and compatibility.

⌨️ Admin Commands
Manage the plugin in real-time with built-in tab suggestions:

/ba on - Enables the plugin features globally.

/ba off - Disables the plugin (reverts to vanilla anvil behavior).

/ba lv <number> - Sets the maximum allowed XP level cost (Max: 500).

/ba - Displays the help menu with all available commands.

🔧 Installation & Permissions
Drop the .jar file into your /plugins folder.

Restart your server.

Ensure admins have the betteranvil.admin permission (given to OPs by default).
